replication_definition: Same JH01 proposition, measurement semantics, ordered panel, decision convention, and estimator family on a genuinely new temporal sample disjoint from the discovery evaluation history; not a same-history reproduction, implementation reproduction, sensitivity analysis, survivor-panel analysis, or pooled extension.

decision_schedule.calendar_rule: Fixed inclusive daily calendar window selected ex ante; it may not be moved, shortened, or otherwise changed after availability or outcome inspection.

required_raw_coverage.bar_time_semantics: A bar is identified by open time and closes one hour later. C_i,h is the close of the 1h bar ending at close boundary h.
required_raw_coverage.derivation: The first feature return is r_m at close boundary t-23h and requires its preceding close, hence the 2025-07-18T23:00:00Z opening bar. The final outcome return ends at the close boundary t+24h, hence the 2026-07-19T23:00:00Z opening bar.

measurement.return_semantics: r_i,h = log(C_i,h / C_i,h-1), with finite strictly positive closes required for every exact panel member.
measurement.market_return: r_m,h = (1/20) * sum_i r_i,h over the exact ordered 20-symbol panel; no capitalization, volume, availability, or survivor weighting.

classification.REPLICATED_WITHIN_FROZEN_TEMPORAL_SCOPE: Execution complete, beta > 0, 95% HAC CI entirely > 0, and raw two-sided p <= 0.05.
classification.OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_WITHIN_FROZEN_TEMPORA: Execution complete, beta < 0, 95% HAC CI entirely < 0, and raw two-sided p <= 0.05.
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: Execution complete and neither completed-execution condition applies.
classification.BLOCKED_BY_INPUT_CONTRACT: Any frozen provenance, universe, coverage, continuity, bar-time, decision-schedule, safe-known-after, outcome-boundary, finite-value, or identity contract fails.

required_later_proof: Replication decision dates do not overlap discovery decisions.
Replication outcome dates do not overlap discovery outcomes.
Replication evaluation market history does not reuse discovery evaluation history.
A new materialized snapshot has a distinct immutable identity and digest and does not alias the source snapshot.
The exact new-history coverage contract is authenticated.

panel_failure_semantics: If any exact panel member cannot satisfy the frozen window, classify BLOCKED_BY_INPUT_CONTRACT. Do not drop, replace, reweight, shorten, move, or otherwise repair the panel/window.

post_freeze_amendments.before_outcome_access: A material scientific correction requires explicit superseding preregistration lineage.
post_freeze_amendments.after_outcome_access: Do not mutate this confirmatory contract in place; a redesign is a new experiment or generation.

jigsaw_index_eligibility: NOT_A_JIGSAW_EVIDENCE_PIECE; this preregistration is not eligible for index discovery or self-ingestion.
